verdict.rationale: The skill runs inside an AI agent and gives AI-generated suggestions on the user's own design work. It recommends a concept from the generated options, audits SVGs against logo principles (catching geometry flaws), and flags perception risks such as the wedge reading as watermelon. These are design critiques tied to the user's brief and drafts, not insights drawn from arbitrary user data. missing for 10: analysis of user-supplied datasets or business data, a documented insights/analytics feature beyond design-audit recommendations, independent hands-on corroboration.
